response.sql: SELECT s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat

assumptions.assumption: Conservation records whose zoneref matches no site are excluded (inner join), so the share denominator covers only matched records. Missing insurstat (NULL) forms its own group.
Empty-string insurstat values, if any, are treated as their own distinct status rather than merged with NULL.
